questions.original:
Why do we choose “home owner” to split?
Recall Information Gain in feature selection

answers.chinese: 它能降低不纯度，但不能据此声称候选中最优。
answers.english: The split creates a pure No child and reduces impurity, but it is not the best of all splits in the displayed table. The Married-versus-other split has a larger Gini gain (0.12 versus about 0.0771).

answers.chinese: p.25 的问句指向 Learn Model 框：从同一带标签训练表学习映射，模型可以是决策树，也可以是其他分类器或集成。图示任务不是要求补造某种算法的测试标签。
answers.english: A decision tree is one choice of learning algorithm. Other classifiers or an ensemble can also learn a mapping from the attributes to the class label.

questions.section: p.59 · Support Vector Machines · 哪条更好
questions.original:
Which one is better? B1 or B2?
How do you define better?

answers.chinese: p.60 的讲义给定答案是 B1，再解释比较标准是最大化两侧最近点到边界的余量
answers.english: B1 is better because it has the larger margin on the displayed data. Better means a larger minimum perpendicular distance from the training points to the separating boundary, under the same feature scale.

questions.original: How to classify using SVM once w and b are found? Given a test record, xᵢ

answers.chinese: 先计算内积加截距的分数，再按正负分类。正负 1 是训练间隔边界，原页只写分数至少 1 或至多 -1，漏了中间仍可预测的范围；恰为 0 要预先约定平票。
answers.english: Compute s=wᵀxᵢ+b. Predict +1 if s>0 and -1 if s<0, using a predefined tie rule at s=0. The values +1 and -1 define margin boundaries, not the only scores that can be classified.

questions.original: What if the problem is not linearly separable?

answers.chinese: p.65／66 重复同一问。线性不可分时可用软间隔付费容许违约；若类别结构本身非线性，可再做映射或核。两种处理可合用，不能说不可分就必需核。
answers.english: Use a soft-margin SVM to penalize margin violations. If the structure requires a nonlinear boundary, also consider a feature mapping or kernel; soft margins and kernels can be combined.

questions.original:
Is this data linearly-separable?
How about a quadratic mapping ϕ(xᵢ)?

answers.chinese: p.68 上图是一维蓝点在中间、红点在两端，一个阈值无法分开。保留 x 并增加 x² 后，下图可用直线分开；下文平方坐标小例另用自拟数据演示，不把图中无刻度位置当精确数值。
answers.english: The displayed one-dimensional data cannot be separated by a single threshold. Mapping each point to (x,x²) allows a linear separator in the enlarged feature space for this displayed pattern.

questions.original: What if decision boundary is not linear?

answers.chinese: p.69 图中红圆在中心、蓝方在外围。原页把中心 (0.5,0.5) 的半径 0.2 以内标 -1，外侧标 +1；边界等号按原式 otherwise 也归 -1。可以映射坐标后求线性面，回到原空间得到曲线。p.70 的 u、v 直线见前文。
answers.english: A suitable feature mapping can turn the nonlinear separation into a linear one in another space. In the page-69 rule, points with distance greater than 0.2 from (0.5,0.5) have label +1; all other points have label -1.

questions.original:
Comparison between logistic regression and support vector machine
How does SVM build a separation boundary

answers.chinese: 第一问比较训练目标和输出：LR 用概率及对数损失，SVM 用间隔分数及违约惩罚。第二问讲如何建边界：在规范化约束下求最大间隔，不可分时加松弛，非线性时可用核。以下比较表与步骤是参考解析，原页无标准答案。
answers.english: Logistic regression models class probabilities using log loss, while an SVM learns a margin-based decision score. An SVM finds a large-margin separator under normalized constraints, adding slack penalties and possibly a kernel when needed.

questions.original:
For 1000 bank transactions, only 1 transaction is a fraud transaction
I have a classifier with a classification accuracy equals to 99.9%, is this a good classifier?

answers.chinese: p.77／78 是同题和反例。不能只凭 99.9% 认定好：全判正常就有 999/1000 正确，但唯一欺诈漏掉，recall 为 0。须和该基线、少数类指标及业务成本比较。
answers.english: Accuracy alone is insufficient. Predicting every transaction as non-fraud gives 99.9% accuracy but zero fraud recall, so the confusion matrix, minority-class metrics, and business costs are needed.

questions.section: p.83 · Alternative Measures · 银行经理题
questions.original:
If you are a bank manager,
Which number do you care most?
a, b, c, d?

answers.chinese: 本页给 a=10、b=20、c=50、d=10000，行是真实类、列是预测类；Yes 为欺诈。若漏欺诈代价最高，会特别关注 b=FN，同时检查误报 c 和检出 a，不能脱离成本宣布永远只有一格重要。这是开放题，课堂也逐格解释代价。
answers.english: If missed fraud is most costly, pay particular attention to b (false negatives), while also considering a (detected fraud) and c (false alarms). The business cost matrix determines the trade-off; there is no universally dominant cell.

questions.section: p.67 · Support Vector Machines · 两因素
questions.original: Find the hyperplane that optimizes both factors

answers.chinese: 原图没有精确坐标或给定的 C，不能指定唯一的数值最优线
answers.english: Use the soft-margin objective to balance a wide margin and violations, with C controlling the penalty. The drawing lacks the coordinates and C needed to identify a unique numerical optimum.
